items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: And they wrote, “It’s going to be hotter backstage than it is on stage with the two Ettas back there. But we were friends.

ctx.x: It was probably ‘61. Something like that. We were at the Regal Theater together and they came. And then they had us back to back with our guns in the air. And they wrote, “It’s going to be hotter backstage than it is on stage with the two Ettas back there. But we were friends.
